_comment: Edit this file to change what gets analyzed. Symbols are Yahoo Finance tickers.
_premarket: The premarket board: every refreshMinutes from 4:00am ET to the open. limit is how many discovered names are measured on top of the watchlist; minHintPct is the premarket move a screened name needs before it is worth measuring; minPremarketDollarVolume is the turnover it needs before it is shown at all. dataUrl is where the deployed page polls for fresh scans.
